policy: TLDR AI is a curated news discovery channel, not a scholarly database or verification source. Selected editorial signal summaries are transformed into project engineering hypotheses. No newsletter text is copied.

signals.title: Finance agents need end-to-end, rubric-based evaluation
signals.action: Create financial work case sets with supporting files and expert pass/fail rubrics; do not equate benchmark success with audit competence.
